entities.summary: Max Görtz is a Swedish professional ice hockey forward. He is currently playing with Fischtown Pinguins in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Görtz was selected by the Nashville Predators in the 6th round of the 2012 NHL Entry Draft.
